title: Orsen and the Well
author: Elodie Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Joubert, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
